title: Pod Salt Core Cigarette Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just like the real thing only without all the nasties, Pod Salt’s Cigarette is an e-liquid that perfectly captures the rich, earthy tones of tobacco in a smooth and satisfying vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
